title: Biophilic Resilience: Davao Coastal Transit Hub
abstract: An eco-responsive transit intermodal facility addressing coastal storm surges through mangrove-inspired biomimetic structural supports and passive cooling louvers.

title: AgriBot: Autonomous Crop Health Telemetry Rover
abstract: Edge AI embedded robotics navigating cacao plantations to detect pest anomalies using custom lightweight convolutional neural networks with LoRa transmission.

title: Tuned Mass Dampers for Davao Seismic Zones
abstract: Experimental performance analysis of modular liquid column dampers in mid-rise structural frames exposed to Eastern Mindanao fault line ground acceleration curves.
